name: Farzad Ahmadkhanlou
abstract: Quantum Entanglement is a well-established phenomenon at the atomic and subatomic levels. However, it is a spooky part of our world, as it apparently conflicts with Einstein’s theory of special relativity, since the information would have to be delivered faster than light speed. There are many other unanswered questions that require a paradigm shift in how we view the universe. This paper presents the relationship between consciousness and entanglement from the quantum to the galactic level. Acc
